scope: Terminal closure of the native-frame source-uncertainty pilot; read-only synthesis of the two pilot receipts

decision.verdict: The ten native source-uncertainty channels regress the paired pilot by 0.6247%; the Q24 host's own approximation-quality observables carry no autonomous residual signal. The frame ambiguity left by the Q closure is resolved: the observer plateau is not wrong-frame channels.

family_synthesis.conclusion: Five materially different arms spanning operator classes and information supply in both frames bracket the residual-observer program at its information ceiling (~3.23e-8 development OOF; ~3.11e-8 native pilot). The missing autonomous state is not a function of any lawful host observable; it is the accumulated interaction between the host's approximation and the specific network, visible only against truth. Reaching raw 1e-8 therefore requires improving the host itself.
family_synthesis.licensed_successor: One design-only host-error-mechanism localization node: read-only attribution of the host's error against truth onto host mechanisms and the newly exported source-uncertainty maps, selecting exactly one targeted host improvement for its own preregistered node.
